name: review-3402
description: Env: Read VALKEYCLI_HOST and VALKEYCLI_PORT environment variables
author: Dietr1ch

maintainer_comments.author: zuiderkwast
maintainer_comments.body:
parseEnv is called after parseOptions. We need to make sure the environment variables don't override an explicit `-h` option.

For AUTH above, the check is `auth != NULL && config.conn_info.auth == NULL`. We can do something similar for host and port, i.e. initialize `config.conn_info.host = NULL` and `config.conn_info.port = 0` and check if they're still zero here, and after the call to parseEnv, check if they're still zero set them to the default values ("127.0.0.1", 6379).

maintainer_comments.author: zuiderkwast
maintainer_comments.body: Yeah, reading env before options is the cleanest. I thought it would be affecting more things, but it looks simple.

maintainer_comments.author: zuiderkwast
maintainer_comments.body: Don't leave two blank lines here. One blank line is enough.
